topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling can lead to reduced link budgets for safety-critical services, potentially impacting their reliability and performance.
reference_context: Link budgets depend on parameters like antenna diameters, efficiencies, and noise temperatures, with applications signaling required capacity and admission control managing available capacity.
